qualityLabelMeaning: 110 means independently checked completed work, not detector quality. Blocked experiments are not negative results.

objectives.question: Are lineage, primary sources, model/data rights and resources admissible?
objectives.crossCheck: Pinned authoritative code/model cards and local hashes

objectives.question: Do both frozen loaders and the RIGID arithmetic agree with upstream safely?
objectives.experiment: Ten non-evaluation fixtures per arm, zero noise, replay, dimensions, runtime
objectives.crossCheck: Independent upstream arithmetic/loader equivalence and four real calibration-parent replays
limitations: Not reproduction of the published dataset benchmark

objectives.question: Can source/family-separated fitting, calibration and evaluation roles be supported?
objectives.experiment: Score-blind freeze with rights, source/prompt/duplicate and reserve controls

objectives.question: Does frozen response recover useful evidence; does it exceed a legitimate A0?
objectives.experiment: Single fixed seed and three-draw mean across declared conditions
objectives.crossCheck: Seed/resume equivalence, same-tensor reference and independent row metrics
limitations: All thresholds frozen before evaluation; no result available yet

objectives.question: Do modern frozen features and rights-permitted clean/augmented heads improve the tradeoff?
objectives.experiment: One PE identity; B0/B1 legitimate fitting completed; evaluation follows A unload
objectives.crossCheck: Train-only standardization, permutation, exact refitting and independent metrics
limitations: One positive training family; eight negative calibration parents

objectives.question: Can broad human-created digital-content specificity be evaluated?
objectives.experiment: Inventory approved unsealed materialized artwork/CGI/game controls
objectives.crossCheck: Current registry and historical cohort/source roles audited
limitations: Eight procedural templates do not replace representative human-created digital works; no sealed screenshots accessed

objectives.question: Do findings survive negatives, nuisance, generator, seed, codec and input controls?
objectives.experiment: Frozen matched views, transformations, separate negative strata and source-worst outcomes
objectives.crossCheck: Independent principal counts and positive-case/negative-panel replay

objectives.question: Are results reproducible and correctly bounded in an unmerged stacked PR?
objectives.experiment: H-M regressions, numerical/contract tests, final report and PR
objectives.crossCheck: Separate audit, fresh checkout and live PR lineage
